name: Alnashetri
sum: Small Early Cretaceous alvarezsaurian from La Buitrera, Argentina, known from hind limbs and a more complete skeleton described in 2026.
holotype: MPCA-477, articulated hind limbs of one individual, Candeleros Formation, Río Negro, Argentina.
material: Two specimens; a more complete skeleton found in 2014 was described in 2026 (Makovicky et al. 2026).
biology: Lived in the Albian La Buitrera fauna with the dromaeosaurid Buitreraptor, the snake Najash and the crocodyliform Araripesuchus.
author: Makovicky et al. 2012
